title: Engine-driven whiteboard auto-post
wanted_capability: Engine should auto-post to a whiteboard from a specialist node's strict JSON output when the node is configured for `output_kind: whiteboard_post` — eliminates silent-failure from forgotten tool calls.
notes: Specialists are prompt-instructed to call `whiteboard_post`; silent failure if forgotten. Either completion-gate per node OR engine-driven auto-post from strict JSON output.
resolution_note: Implemented in beta/blackbox-v2 commit 1bd23fb0 as the ensemble `board` node binding. NodeSpec.board (template → board id) has the engine parse each member's STRICT-JSON output into typed BoardActions (post/annotate/vote/none; object or array; fence-tolerant) via bbox-whiteboards parse_board_actions, applied through WhiteboardRegistry::apply_action — the same phase/role/reference checks as the whiteboard_* tools. Attribution from item agent_name, falling back to member name; failures log board_autoapply_skipped/_failed arc events without failing the node (contract enforcement stays with gate packets over whiteboard_summarize). Compile validation: ensemble-only, non-empty template. Also applied at fire-and-forget ensemble join. Live-proven on an isolated daemon: probe arcs posted 3/3 member claims engine-side with zero whiteboard tool calls; whiteboard example's Vote node now uses the binding (motivated by the 2026-07-14 proof run where 2 of 3 specialists skipped whiteboard_vote).
